linhas.en:
Archer's first SG.
A peculiar fondness for the make of his tools and
handling them with care. In Archer's case, you could say
he's one step away from being a military enth#RUBSotaku#RUBEusi#RENDast.

Whatever the case, one should treat things with care.

             ◆

While Archer may be a Heroic Spirit of the Bow, he is,
in truth, a magus rather than a knight.
He makes use of the magic known as "Projection,"
instantly reproducing and using many weapons.
The numerous weapons Archer uses are copies of
"what he once saw, what he fought against."

Projection magic can produce counterfeits out of mana.
To bring it closer to the real thing, he'd need to know
its structure. Archer became a tool maniac for the sake of
improving the precision of his magic…… or so he'd claim.

But he's got no such excuse with electrical appliances.
